value.rationale: The exact boundary gamma=2 is the maximal value allowing a globally defined surplus cut on the entire fully mobilized line. At two natural threshold shapes the conventional isolated period-two attractor is replaced by a continuum of neutral cycles. The theorem distinguishes the opposite global selection sides and derives two model-specific logarithmic vector fields controlling the entire finite-amplitude transient with sharp divergent first-passage times. This quantitatively resolves a physically and dynamically motivated degeneracy and is neither a small numerical gain nor a generic linearization.
